title: Concept: Mongo Express UI in a response
description: A Mongo Express web UI in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Mongo Express lists every database and lets a visitor run queries against the collections behind it, so one reachable page is a full data path.
applicability: Deployments that render a Mongo Express web UI into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Mongo Express lists every database and lets a visitor run queries against the collections behind it, so one reachable page is a full data path.
